hero.heading: Our Services
hero.subheading: Comprehensive rehabilitation and wellness services to help you recover, strengthen, and thrive.

intro.text: At Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness, we offer a full range of rehabilitation services in our 7,500 sq. ft. facility. Whether you're recovering from surgery, managing chronic pain, or looking to improve athletic performance, our experienced team has the expertise and tools to help.

categories.title: Physical Therapy
categories.description: Our physical therapists use evidence-based techniques to help you recover from injuries, surgeries, and chronic conditions. Every treatment plan is customized to your specific needs and goals.
treatments: Manual therapy (myofascial release, trigger point therapy)

categories.title: Aquatic Therapy
categories.description: Our on-site therapeutic pool provides a low-impact environment for rehabilitation. The buoyancy of water reduces stress on joints while allowing you to build strength, improve range of motion, and accelerate recovery.

categories.title: Occupational Therapy & Hand Therapy
categories.description: Our occupational therapy team specializes in upper extremity rehabilitation, helping you regain the hand and arm function needed for daily life and work activities.

categories.title: Sports Medicine & Athletic Training
categories.description: Our athletic training team combines injury rehabilitation with performance conditioning to get athletes back in the game safely and at peak performance.

categories.title: Dry Needling
categories.description: Performed by our certified practitioners, dry needling targets trigger points in muscles to relieve pain, reduce tension, and restore range of motion. This technique is especially effective for chronic muscle tightness and pain.

categories.title: Women's Health
categories.description: Our women's health programs address the unique rehabilitation needs of women, from pelvic floor therapy to pre- and postpartum care.

categories.title: Industrial & Workplace Rehabilitation
categories.description: We help workers recover from occupational injuries and return to their jobs safely through targeted conditioning and ergonomic solutions.

ctaSection.heading: Not Sure Which Service You Need?
ctaSection.text: Contact us and we'll help determine the best treatment approach for your condition. Remember — no referral is required.
